# Online Compass

> A free, browser-based compass tool for accurate directional orientation accessible in 20+ languages without requiring downloads or app installations.

Online Compass provides a virtual compass guide using device magnetometer sensors for navigation and direction finding. The platform supports multiple languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Arabic, Chinese, and many others, making it a globally accessible navigation tool for travelers and users seeking quick directional reference.

## Key Topics

- online compass

## Core Application

- [Online Compass](https://www.onlinecompass.org): Virtual compass guide for accurate directional orientation without downloads
- [Compass App](https://www.onlinecompass.org/app): Main compass application with geolocation and mobile device permissions

## Language Versions

- [Arabic - بوصلة على الإنترنت](https://www.onlinecompass.org/ar): Arabic language online compass for web browser navigation and orientation
- [Spanish - Brújula Online](https://www.onlinecompass.org/es): Spanish language browser-based compass showing cardinal directions
- [French - Compas en ligne](https://www.onlinecompass.org/fr): French language online compass for navigation in web browser
- [German - Online-Kompass](https://www.onlinecompass.org/de): German language online compass showing geographic cardinal directions
- [Italian - Bussola in linea](https://www.onlinecompass.org/it): Italian language online compass using magnetometer in web browser
- [Turkish - Çevremiçi Pusula](https://www.onlinecompass.org/tr): Turkish language online compass using magnetometer sensor for directions
- [Polish - Kompas online](https://www.onlinecompass.org/pl): Polish language online compass for web-based navigation and orientation
- [Swedish - Online kompass](https://www.onlinecompass.org/sv): Swedish language online compass for navigation and orientation
- [Norwegian - Nettkompass](https://www.onlinecompass.org/nb): Norwegian language online compass for navigation and direction finding
- [Danish - Online kompas](https://www.onlinecompass.org/da): Danish language online compass for web browser navigation
- [Ukrainian - Інтернет-компас](https://www.onlinecompass.org/uk): Ukrainian language internet compass for navigation and direction finding
- [Thai - เข็มทิศออนไลน์](https://www.onlinecompass.org/th): Thai language online compass for web-based navigation and orientation
- [Vietnamese - La bàn trực tuyến](https://www.onlinecompass.org/vi): Vietnamese language online compass showing cardinal direction orientation
- [Indonesian - Kompas Online](https://www.onlinecompass.org/id): Indonesian language online compass with magnetometer for directions
- [Hindi - ऑनलाइन कम्पास](https://www.onlinecompass.org/hi): Hindi language online compass for web-based navigation and orientation
- [Malay - Kompas Dalam Talian](https://www.onlinecompass.org/ms): Malay language online compass for navigation and direction finding
